description: F11 Substitute: Aerodactyl (Air Balloon) and Slowbro (Colbur Berry) put up substitutes in the setup turn. Chansey's Seismic Toss breaks Aerodactyl's substitute: no damage reaches Aerodactyl, yet the balloon pops (Air Balloon's `onAfterSubDamage`). Blissey's weak, super-effective Knock Off hits Slowbro's substitute: the Colbur Berry is neither eaten nor halving the damage (`hitSub`), and Knock Off does not take it (no AfterHit against a substitute).
